QA-21912 is **PASS**, but only for the UCLA pair. The Wasserman / Gatorade pair couldn't be run because Gatorade has no Facebook posts in the default week. I appended a PASS line to `results/2026-11-17/results.tsv` too. The report is at `results/2026-11-17/QA-21912-report.md`.

- **UCLA, dev, Facebook only, default range Nov 9–15:** the first post is "ICYMI: The "Mozart of Math"".

| Metric | LFM | Native | Difference |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reactions | 646 | 684 | native +5.9% |
| Comments | 11 | 13 | native +2 |
| Shares | 77 | 85 | native +10.4% |

  The case gives no numeric threshold, and I judged these as no big variation. Native is always higher, which fits the post still accruing after LFM's stats pull. The logged-out Facebook post page loaded this time, though earlier runs show it can hit a login wall.
- **Wasserman / Gatorade:** I picked the exact "Gatorade" result and set Facebook only, and the page showed `Posts (0)`. It stayed at 0 after a 15-second recheck. I didn't substitute a brand or date, so this pair isn't a verified pass or fail.
- **Case notes vs spec:** the Notes line in `cases/QA-21912.md` lists different Tuesday accounts than the Jira Description table. I followed the table.
- **Open bugs:** none linked, so the case ran normally.
- **Cleanup:** nothing was created or saved, and the native tab is closed.

I didn't update any skill or REGISTRY files; the report's closing notes list what to add for harvest.sh.
